description: Create a wiki page from Markdown in a space you can write to. Hangs off the space home page unless you name a parent (by 'parentId', or by 'parentTitle' within the same space). Returns the new page id and its URL. Mention someone as [@Their Name](user:username) — on a wiki page that is the form that notifies, not the [~username] used in issues; link another page as [text](page:Title) or [text](page:SPACE/Title). Answers with 'notified' (who this actually reaches) and 'unresolvedMentions' (what looked like a mention and reached nobody, each with a reason) — a wrong handle is stored as written and never refused, so that list is the only sign it did not land.

labels.description: Labels to set, space or comma separated.

markdown.description: Page body as Markdown, which also carries $…$ / $$…$$ LaTeX formulas and the wiki's macros on a line of their own — {toc}, {children}, {info} … {info}, {expand:title=…} … {expand}.

parentId.description: Parent page id. Omit to hang the page off the space home page.

parentTitle.description: Parent page title, as an alternative to 'parentId'. Must be a page in the same space.

spaceKey.description: Space key, e.g. 'PM'. Every project has exactly one space, keyed like the project.

title.description: Page title. Must be unique within the space — the title is how pages are addressed here.

name: create_wiki_page
